title: Vigia plugin manifest
description: plugin.json: the single manifest of a Vigia plugin. Declares identity, the classes the host instantiates, dimensions and webhooks.

$schema.description: Path or URL of this schema, for editor support. Ignored by the host.

id.description: Plugin id in dotted lowercase form, for example vigia.check.http. Must match the plugin folder name.

version.description: Plugin version (major.minor.patch). Must match the version folder name.

sdk.description: SDK major the plugin is built against.

entry.description: Entry assembly file name, next to plugin.json.

description.description: What the plugin does, in one or two sentences.

class.description: Full name of the class implementing ICheck (usually Check<TConfig>) in the entry assembly.

config.description: Full name of the config record in the entry assembly. Must be the TConfig of Check<TConfig>.

defaultInterval.description: Interval for checks that do not set one. Default 1m.

dimensions.description: Measurements the check may report. Reporting an undeclared one makes the probe an error.

webhooks.description: Webhooks each check of this plugin receives at /api/v1/hooks/{check}/{name}. Declaring one is what enables it.

typeName.description: Full .NET type name, for example Acme.Check.Ping.PingCheck.

direction.description: Which way the value gets worse.

unit.description: Display unit, for example ms, d, %.

class.description: Full name of the class implementing IWebhookHandler in the entry assembly.

description.description: What calling it means, shown next to the URL.
